# Use cases

<!-- generated by catalog/kf_catalogo.py render from docs/catalogo.json: edit the JSON, not this file -->

Each use case links to the test that runs it end to end, or `por cobrir`. Edge cases: [edge-cases.md](edge-cases.md).

| ID | I want to... | Run | You get | Test |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| UC-001 | Start a project with the Kaizen workflow | `kaizen init --harness codex` | skills, prompts, `sp-*` scripts, an `AGENTS.md` block; existing files are kept | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-001 kaizen init instala o workflow e preserva ficheiros` |
| UC-002 | Check the install is healthy (CI, new machine) | `kaizen doctor --harness codex` | rc 0 when complete, rc 1 and a list of what is missing | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-002 kaizen doctor dá rc 0 completo e rc 1 com o que falta` |
| UC-003 | Repair a broken or partial install | `kaizen doctor --harness codex --fix` | missing pieces restored, nothing overwritten | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-003 kaizen doctor --fix repõe sem sobrescrever` |
| UC-004 | See what my agents cost this month | `kaizen usage --days 30` | totals by day, model, session and 5 h window (API-equivalent USD) | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-004 kaizen usage mostra totais por dia e modelo` |
| UC-005 | Compare Claude and Codex spend | `kaizen usage --source claude,codex` | one table across both transcript stores | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-005 kaizen usage junta Claude e Codex numa tabela` |
| UC-006 | Keep a weekly record | `kaizen report --week 2026-W42` | a metrics-only Markdown note in `reportsDir` | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-006 kaizen report escreve a nota semanal só com métricas` |
| UC-007 | Price a model not in the bundled table | add it to your prices file, set `"prices"` in `kaizen.config.json` | cost instead of `n/a` | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-007 preços em kaizen.config.json dão custo em vez de n/a` |
| UC-008 | List my open stories | `kaizen status` | pending SPs by status and priority | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-008 kaizen status lista as histórias por estado e prioridade` |
| UC-009 | Cost of one period only | `kaizen usage --since 2026-10-01` | same tables from that date | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-009 kaizen usage --since corta o período` |
| UC-010 | Show only one harness | `kaizen usage --source codex --top 10` | Codex only, top 10 sessions | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-010 kaizen usage --source codex --top mostra só um harness` |
| UC-011 | Read transcripts copied from another machine | `kaizen usage --codex-root ./backup/sessions` | totals from that folder | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-011 kaizen usage --codex-root lê transcripts copiados` |
| UC-012 | Preview a weekly report without writing | `kaizen report --week 2026-W42 --print` | Markdown on stdout | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-012 kaizen report --print mostra a nota sem escrever` |
| UC-013 | Write reports somewhere else | `kaizen report --out docs/usage` | `docs/usage/YYYY-WNN.md` | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-013 kaizen report --out escreve noutra pasta` |
| UC-014 | Plan a feature as a story | `python scripts/sp-new.py --project _default --slug login --priority P2` | an empty 8-section story in `sp/TODO` | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-014 sp-new cria uma história de 8 secções em TODO` |

| UC-026 | Run a command on workflow events | add [`kaizen-hooks.json`](config.md#kaizen-hooksjson) | `kaizen_hooks.py fire` runs it | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-026 kaizen-hooks.json corre um comando num evento` |
| UC-027 | Move to a fresh context mid-story | `/sp-handoff` | resume command injected in the pane, or copied to the clipboard | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-027 sp-handoff regista o progresso e prepara a retoma` |
| UC-028 | Choose how a program's children run | `sp-execucao.py <parent> sequencial\|paralelo` | sets `execucao:` on the parent story; `/michi` and `/sp-fila` read it | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-028 sp-execucao grava sequencial ou paralelo na mãe` |
| UC-029 | Measure edge case and use case coverage | `kaizen catalog` (`--check`, `render`, `--json`) | covered/total for EC and UC; rc 0 only at EC >= 0.9 and UC = 1.0 | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-029 kaizen catalog mede EC e UC` |
| UC-030 | Resume a story after a crash, Ctrl+C or closed pane | `kaizen resume <story>` | continues from the last journaled phase and step | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-030 kaizen resume retoma após o processo morrer a meio` |
| UC-031 | Resume from a chosen phase | `kaizen resume <story> --from <phase>` | earlier phases kept, the run restarts at that phase | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-031 kaizen resume --from começa na fase pedida` |
| UC-032 | Throw away a broken run and start the story again | `kaizen resume <story> --restart` | journal reset, story back to its first phase, files kept | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-032 kaizen resume --restart pede confirmação e arquiva o checkpoint` |
| UC-033 | Run a whole program from its parent | `/sp-fila --programa <parent>` | children run in the parent's `execucao:` order; the parent closes after the last one | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-033 sp-fila --programa corre os filhos pela ordem da mãe` |
| UC-034 | Continue a program from a child already started | `/sp-fila --programa <parent>` with a child in Doing | the running child is resumed, not relaunched; the rest follow | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-034 sp-fila --programa retoma o filho já em Doing` |
| UC-035 | Give a UI project a checked design system | `kaizen ds init <project>` / `validate` / `export` | `DESIGN.md` + DTCG `design/tokens.json` (contrast and aliases validated), exported to `tokens.css` and a Tailwind preset | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-035 kaizen ds gera e valida o design system do projeto` |
| UC-036 | Let the queue recover a blocked pane by itself when the story already allows it | `/sp-fila` with the watcher running | context and covered-authorization blocks are answered in the same pane (max 2 per story); anything else is left to the user | `core/scripts/test_sp_vigia_reacao.py::test_autorizacao_coberta_responde_e_volta_a_correr` |
| UC-037 | Send text to, read or close a pane by its readable name | `kaizen term orq acao enviar\|ler\|matar <name>` (e.g. `sp-<slug>`, `kaizen`) | the name resolves to the pane (id still works); `kaizen` is never closed; `kaizen term ls` shows the NAME column | `core/scripts/test_kf_term_orq.py::test_enviar_por_nome` |
| UC-038 | State a project goal once, in a checked file the factory can read | `kaizen vision init <project>` / `validate <project>/VISION.md` / `resumo` | `VISION.md` with frontmatter (`projeto`, `ui`, `stack`, `design_system`, `orcamento`) and fixed sections; `validate` exits 0 only when everything is filled and every success criterion has a command or an observation | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-038 kaizen vision gera e valida o VISION.md do projeto` |
| UC-039 | Turn a validated VISION.md into a program of ready SPs without a human grill | `kaizen vision decompor <project>/VISION.md` | a mother SP plus one child per milestone in `sp/TODO` (acyclic dependencies, executable gates, `modo: auto`); re-running creates nothing new | `tests/e2e-use-cases.test.js::UC-039 kaizen vision decompor cria o programa de SPs` |
| UC-040 | Make every autonomous SP of a project pass the same quality gates before merge | `qualidade` in `kaizen.config.json`; `sp-gates.py <SP> --repo R`; `pr_fechar.py <PR> --sp S` | profile gates join the SP's own; a red blocking gate (or a missing clean pentest / approved review) means no merge and the SP set to `bloqueado` with the reason | `core/scripts/test_pr_fechar.py::test_gate_bloqueante_vermelho_nao_faz_merge_e_bloqueia_sp` |
| UC-041 | Make design quality a blocking gate for every `ui: sim` SP | `kaizen ds lint`; `kaizen ds verify [--atualizar-baselines]`; `sp-gates.py <SP> --repo R` | a literal colour outside the tokens fails `ds-lint` with `file:line`; fixed to a token it passes; `ds-verify` writes `design/relatorio.json` (axe, visual diff vs baselines); the gates are injected only for `ui: sim` SPs | `core/scripts/test_ds_gates.py::test_lint_corrigido_para_token_passa` |
| UC-042 | Drive the factory by hand: approve the backlog, run one story at a time, pause, skip or take over a story | `kaizen factory run --manual <project>` / `approve [--so a,b]` / `step` / `pause\|resume\|skip\|takeover <project> <sp>` | the factory decomposes and waits for approval; approved stories run one `step` at a time; a taken-over story is closed by the same gates and budget when the human finishes it | `core/scripts/test_kf_factory.py::test_ec_099_takeover_a_factory_nao_toca_e_fecha_com_os_mesmos_gates` |
